Project — 02 / 09Multi-Tenant SaaS · 2025

WorkTrackZilla

A multi-tenant employee monitoring SaaS — a web dashboard for managers plus a desktop agent for employees, built on a Django and Next.js stack.

Django 5Next.js 15ElectronCeleryRedisMinIO / S3PostgreSQLDocker

Full-stack product

My role

Dharmike Baria on GitHub ↗

01The problem

Teams needed one platform to track work activity across multiple client organisations, with each organisation's data kept separate and secure.

02How it works

01

Desktop agent captures activity

An Electron app runs on employee machines and records work activity.

02

Tenant-scoped API

Data is sent to the Django 5 backend, which scopes every record to its own organisation.

03

Background processing

Celery workers backed by Redis handle heavy tasks away from the request path.

04

Storage

Files go to MinIO / S3 object storage; structured data lives in PostgreSQL.

05

Manager dashboard

Managers review team activity in the Next.js 15 dashboard.

03What I built

  • Architected a Django 5 backend with multi-tenant data isolation so each organisation only sees its own data.
  • Built the manager dashboard in Next.js 15.
  • Shipped an Electron desktop agent that captures work activity on employee machines.
  • Ran background processing with Celery and Redis, stored files in MinIO / S3, and containerised everything with Docker on PostgreSQL.

04Key features

Multi-tenant isolation

Many organisations on one platform, each seeing only its own data.

Desktop tracking agent

Cross-platform Electron app for employees.

Manager dashboard

Next.js 15 web app for reviewing activity.

Async jobs

Celery + Redis keep the API fast.

Object storage

MinIO / S3 for files and captures.

Containerised

The whole stack runs in Docker.

05Challenges & solutions

ChallengeKeeping each organisation's data separate in one shared platform.
SolutionDesigned tenant-scoped data access in the Django backend so every query is limited to its organisation.
ChallengeHeavy processing slowing down API responses.
SolutionMoved long-running work to Celery workers backed by Redis.
ChallengeStoring large files without bloating the database.
SolutionUsed MinIO / S3 object storage and kept only references in PostgreSQL.

06Impact

4Apps in one platform — API, dashboard, desktop agent, workers
MultiTenant architecture with isolated organisation data
DockerFully containerised deployment
